name: Luma
description:
Whether you're getting into AI or training for a fall marathon, you can find likeminded people on Luma. Join a paper reading or run club to get one step closer to your goals.

Luma powers millions of events around the world. So whether you're into knitting or kiting, you'll be able to find something to join.

If you're hosting an event, you can use this connector to help keep track of and manage your upcoming events.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Luma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Luma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.luma.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Luma MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luma provides these MCP tools: get_calendar, get_event, get_guest, get_self, list_calendars, list_events, list_guests, and search_events.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Luma?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Luma in media-entertainment on the Manufact MCP catalog include Credits.fm, SceneF, HANKOOKILBO MCP, Ticketbox.vn, and drawnames.
Luma requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Luma is developed by Luma. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
